module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    output reg [3:0] q
);

// Counter state
reg [3:0] count = 4'b0001; // Initial count to 1

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        count <= 4'b0001; // Reset counter to 1
    end else begin
        count <= count + 1; // Increment counter on positive edge of clk
    end
end

assign q = count; // Output the current count

endmodule

module TopModule(
  input  clk,
  input  load,
  input  [9:0] data, // 10-bit data
  output tc
);

reg [9:0] counter; // 10-bit down-counter
reg tc_reg; // D flip-flop to store tc value

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (load) begin
    counter <= data; // Load counter with data
    tc_reg <= 0; // Reset tc signal
  end else begin
    if (counter > 0) begin
      counter <= counter - 1; // Decrement counter
    end
    if (counter == 0) begin
      tc_reg <= 1; // Set tc signal when counter reaches 0
    end
  end
end

assign tc = tc_reg; // Assign tc signal to output

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input load,
    input [9:0] data,
    output reg tc
);
    reg [9:0] counter;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            counter <= data; // Load the counter with the input data
            tc <= 0; // Reset terminal count when loading new value
        end else if (counter > 0) begin
            counter <= counter - 1; // Decrement the counter
            if (counter == 1) begin
                tc <= 1; // Assert terminal count when reaching 0
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (counter == 0) begin
            tc <= 1; // Keep terminal count asserted when counter is 0
        end
    end

endmodule
